reasons: interactive-exploit is skipped because required evidence is absent in the current SignalProfile.
runners.summary: interactive-exploit is skipped because required evidence is absent in the current SignalProfile.
runners.description: Stateful interactive exploit loop (request -> observe full response -> decide next request) replacing the blind one-shot code-exec script. Provider-agnostic: drives Anthropic/Gemini/DeepSeek (native function-calling) and ChatGPT-OAuth/local (JSON-action) through ONE loop via the adapter layer. Primary tool http_request; optional bounded tcp_request (persistent in-scope TCP line-protocol connection — printer/PJL, NAS, LDAP, Modbus, MQTT, DNS, Redis, POP3, Git, kubelet 'lite' services) for non_http_lan_tool_gap objectives, native models only. Seeded with recon facts (sinks, source-derived gate tokens, internal listen port, line-protocol grammar + sequencing, target envelope); captured flags become findings tagged methodology=interactive_exploit. Hard-bounded by scope allowlist (HTTP host + explicit TCP host:port), max steps, time budget, max tool errors, and max TCP round-trips.
